source: MaleCNS v1.0 traced-only; existing connectome_source.json and B1 hashes

plastic_contact_mask.rule: Both KC-to-MBON05 contact endpoints in g4(L), and same KC has at least one PAM08-to-KC contact with both endpoints in g4(L)
plastic_contact_mask.aggregation: Runtime pair conductance is split into fixed and plastic contact contributions; only the plastic contribution changes

model_units.weight: nonnegative excitatory or inhibitory magnitude, effect sign stored separately

generic_neuron_assumptions.source: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; not measured MaleCNS physiology

effective_weight_policy.definition: For each target and named effect class, absolute pair strength equals class_gain times source contact count divided by all active source contacts of that class entering the target; sign is separate
effective_weight_policy.source: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; contact count used only as a declared model transform

apl.input: sum of measured KC-to-APL arrivals normalized by all active KC-to-APL contacts; add to decayed state and clip to [0,1]
apl.output: state times inhibitory contact-share magnitude to measured APL targets only
apl.source: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; no ordinary APL spike conversion

plasticity.trace_update: Before each tick decay x_i and d; after weight update add 1 to x_i for each KC spike and fraction of all 25 PAM08 cells spiking to d, each capped at 1
plasticity.weight_update: If both KC and PAM spike in the same tick, apply depression -eta*w0*max(x_pre,1)*P and no potentiation. Otherwise KC spike applies +eta*w0*d_pre and PAM event applies -eta*w0*x_pre*P. P is actual PAM08 spike fraction. Apply only to selected contact contribution and clip after summing events.
plasticity.source: Temporal polarity literature-constrained; equations, constants and bounds ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION

sensory.geometry: 16 equally spaced Gaussian receptive-field centers over visible position; KC source IDs sorted, rank mod 16 selects center

renderer.position_between: linear interpolation in renderer from the current scene clock; encoder receives only current rendered position

first_action.ruleset: OD8 stable native generated lane-one tap notes
first_action.denominator: every eligible note, including no DOWN
first_action.first_down_scope: first emitted lane-one DOWN assigned by A3 causal note-identity contract; later presses never rescue

teaching.early_judged_press: After note consumption and one fixed sensory-latency interval, deliver nonnegative PAM08 pulse; preceding KC trace supports depression
teaching.too_early_null_press: Record early failure but no teaching pulse because the cue may remain visible and temporal polarity is ambiguous
teaching.late_press_or_no_down: Store only the prior outcome category/amplitude; at the next actual visible note onset deliver PAM08 pulse while the new cue's KC drive waits for its fixed sensory latency, so subsequent KC activity can support potentiation
teaching.end_of_sequence_pending_late: Discard and log pending prime; no unseen next cue
teaching.pam_drive: 20 ms artificial current pulse at 2 normalized threshold units times requested amplitude to all 25 PAM08 cells
teaching.spontaneous_pam_activity: Included in local dopamine state and logged

motor.mapping: fixed positive DNp42 spike-count threshold; no trainable decoder

boundary.meaning: artificial autonomous proxy for omitted inputs to MBON05, MBON20 and DNp42
boundary.state: independent stationary ±1 stream per target, continuous across notes and feedback

event_order: background flips and artificial PAM requests
neural integration and simultaneous spike batch
local trace and weight updates from pre-event traces
fixed motor decision and key action
game judgement and new feedback request

training_policy.allowed_changes_after_b3_failure: none within MVP-C1 without an explicit new version and candidate-budget decision
training_policy.frozen_evaluation: same encoder and motor; plasticity and exploration off; fresh notes
